quote: We conduct a user study to evaluate the quality of the model output. We sample 120 articles from PolitiFact and present them in two forms: Baseline (article, posts) and WSDMS (article, misinforming sentences, trees). We then ask 6 users to label the articles and give their confidence in a 5-point Likert Scale, and each person is given only one form to avoid cross influence.
guideline: users are asked to label the articles and give their confidence in a 5-point Likert Scale
